ravi: Heads-up: scheduling a REGIONAL evacuation simulation for ap-east-1 next Tue 23:30 UTC. Window 30m. Goal: simulate whole-subnet evacuation and validate routing reconvergence, warm-standby scale-up, and SLO tagging. Expect short 5xx tails; no planned customer downtime.

kevin: Added. Are we doing full subnet evac or targeted subset?

ravi: Full worker-subnet evac of the active inference fleet (workers only). Control-plane remains writable. We'll shift traffic to standby regions and validate state-sync.

anya: I'll update the runbook and add muted alert rules. Please post exact abort thresholds and the alert queries.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1793000000 | start: 2026-10-21T23:30:00Z | duration: 30m | owner: ravi

marie: Load plan: ramp 0->350 TPS over 5m, hold 20m, ramp down 5m. Mix: 60% text-gen, 30% streaming-chat, 10% embeddings. Tag runs with evac/1793000000. Will post run metadata.

ravi: Abort criteria:
- global 5m error rate for inference > 3%
- p95 latency increase > 600ms above baseline for >5m
- sustained streaming disconnects > 2% for >3m
If abort, immediately re-enable subnet and failback routing.

kevin: Paste of alert queries (promql) for exact matching:
```
# global inference 5xx ratio > 3%
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\"}[5m])) > 0.03
# streaming disconnects > 2%
sum(rate(stream_disconnects_total{job=\"inference\"}[3m])) / sum(rate(stream_sessions_total{job=\"inference\"}[3m])) > 0.02
# p95 latency delta
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"inference\"}[5m])) by (le)) > (baseline_p95 + 0.6)
```

anya: Preflight checklist: `scripts/evac_preflight.sh ap-east-1` will validate kv-replica health, warm-standby capacity, and route-table readiness. I'll run nightly until the exercise.

zack: Mute plan: scope mutes to `inference.5xx.alert` and `stream.disconnects` for the window; preserve paging for control-plane write errors. I'll push the mute rules and document them in the runbook.

ops-comm: I'll prepare a status page blurb and targeted PMs to customers who have high traffic in ap-east-1. Banner copy will say "resilience exercise" and include a support link.

marie: Observability note: tag all metrics with `maintenance:evac_ap-east1` and set a 2hr post-check sweep for SLO drift. We'll also capture increased sampling of error traces for 30m after run.

kevin: Operator steps (short):
1) preflight: `rjctl evac-precheck --region=ap-east-1`
2) start evac: `rjctl subnet-evacuate --region=ap-east-1 --subnet=worker-subnet --dry-run=false --reason=\"evac-sim\"`
3) monitor dashboards + alerts
4) if abort -> `rjctl subnet-cancel-evac --region=ap-east-1`

ravi: Who's primary oncall?

kevin: I'll be primary, ravi backup. Anya owns the runbook and prechecks, zack owns mutes, marie owns loadgen and traces, ops-comm owns comms.

anya: Preflight is green: mirror lag <90s, kv replicas healthy, standby capacity reports 20% spare headroom. Posting preflight output to thread.

marie: Loadgen ready. I'll start the run at window start, logs and trace bundles will be uploaded here.

zack: Mutes applied. Kept escalation for control-plane writes.

ops-comm: Status banner scheduled 30m before start. PMs queued.

kevin: Reminder: tag metrics with `maintenance:evac_ap-east1` before starting. We'll exclude the window from SLO per policy if the rjops ticket + tags are present.

ravi: Quick checklist final: preflight green, mutes in place, loadgen ready, comms sent. Proceed unless preflight regresses. :white_check_mark:

marie: After the run I'll post raw traces and a short summary within 2 hours.

anya: Noted. If any preflight failures show up tonight we push the exercise. Otherwise proceed as scheduled.

kevin: Thanks everyone. Ping me immediately if you see abort thresholds tripped during the window.

zack: :thumbsup:
